name: ielts-writing-agent
title_zh: 考官视角批改雅思小作文，给分给到小数点
tagline_zh: 写作卡6.5？让前考官思维帮你揪出隐性扣分点。从图表到范文，逐句诊断，附9分示范和双语精讲，练一次顶十次。
tagline_en: Stuck at 6.5? Get examiner-level diagnosis of hidden deductions, with Band 9 models and bilingual breakdowns—each.
desc_en: IELTS Academic Task 1 writing coach and examiner workflow. Use when the user asks to mark, score, polish, explain, teach, or export an IELTS Academic Task 1 essay from a prompt, chart image, or student response, especially for study-abroad IELTS preparation. Produces strict scoring, problem diagnosis, Band 9 model answer, bilingual model explanation, task-type writing guide, vocabulary/sentence st
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈的润色，而是按官方评分标准逐项打分，连小分都标出来。诊断具体到哪句话丢分、怎么改。
why_en: Not generic polishing—it scores against official criteria, pinpoints exactly which sentence loses marks, and shows how to fix.
limit_zh: 只认雅思学术类小作文（Task 1），不碰大作文。需要用户提供题目或图表描述；若只有中文思路，需先自行译成英文。
limit_en: Only IELTS Academic Task 1 (charts/graphs), not Task 2. Requires prompt or chart description; Chinese outlines must be translated first. No.
title_en: IELTS Academic Task 1 examiner-grade scoring & feedback
